name: Methscopolamine

fda.text: In the presence of high environmental temperature, heat prostration (fever and heat stroke due to decreased sweating) can occur with drug use. summary: Using this drug in high temperatures can cause fever and heat stroke from decreased sweating [3]. Loose, watery bowel movements might also be an early sign of a partial blockage in the intestines, especially for people with surgical openings like an ileostomy or colostomy [3]. In addition, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated low risk scores of 24 for the liver and 16 for the heart [M].
